BL-1831 — check_bounce_revert_scope.sh attributes a single-commit Revert to whichever ticket was bounced most recently anywhere (it has no merge second parent to walk), so it refuses the very revert BL-1576's merge-drop guard prescribes (the documenter's BL-1815 revert was judged as BL-1820 on 2026-09-30) - a single-commit revert is judged against the ticket its reverted commit names, and a ticket with no bounce record is not a bounce revert
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A new feature file needs your tap; no choice is posed. FIRM: a merge revert keeps today's attribution (second-parent walk, BL-1471's feature green). FIRM: a single-commit revert is attributed through the reverted commit's own subject ticket id, read with the repo's existing commit-ticket-id reading…
BL-1831 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1831" (or "reject BL-1831 <reason>") to act.
